platform: GovReady-Q Assessment Engine (NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 Profile)
system: G1-Warrant Deterministic Autonomous Remediation, Containment & Attestation Control Plane

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.mechanism: internal/warrant/engine.go + internal/server/api.go Scoped Auditor Bearer Isolation
controls.narrative: Every autonomous rollout, Cilium containment bridge, and exception resolution is gated by cryptographic Standing Warrant verification (fail-closed on missing, expired, or out-of-scope warrants). External 3PAO auditor bearer tokens (g1aud_*) are strictly isolated to /api/v1/auditor/* and return HTTP 403 on all operational endpoints.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.mechanism: cmd/warrant-extractor + k8s/network-policy.yaml (Zero-Egress Content vs. Artifact Separation)
controls.narrative: Untrusted external prose (SARIF 2.1.0, CISA KEV feeds, Google OSV.dev advisories, CycloneDX VEX, git diffs) is routed exclusively through the zero-privilege warrant-extractor service deployed on an isolated zero-egress network segment, emitting only regex-validated typed records.

controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.mechanism: policies/warrant_ac5.rego + internal/crypto/dsse.go (2-of-2 Dual-Key Separation of Duties)
controls.narrative: Standing Warrants, Fleet Thaws, and Ceiling Exceptions require 2-of-2 cryptographic signatures over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized DSSEv1 PAE bytes from two distinct human principals holding disjoint institutional roles: Slot 1 SERVICE_OWNER and Slot 2 AUTHORIZING_OFFICIAL. Production SDKs and CLIs ship zero demo signers.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.narrative: All Standing Warrant issuances, short-lived Task Warrant delegations (TTL <= 300s), extractor sanitizations, progressive canary transitions, containment bridges, quarantined rollbacks, and POA&M closures generate structured, millisecond-timestamped cryptographic audit records with SHA-256 input/output lineage.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information | Cryptographic Protection
controls.mechanism: db/migrations/001..003 + internal/ledger/anchor.go External Merkle Transparency Anchor
controls.narrative: PostgreSQL BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers enforce append-only immutability across warrant_envelopes, agent_action_ledger, attestation_records, and ledger_checkpoints, while TransparencyAnchor ships DSSE-signed binary Merkle Root checkpoints to an external WORM file/webhook boundary so even PostgreSQL superuser trigger-disable rewrites are cryptographically detected.

controls.title: Non-repudiation
controls.narrative: Warrants, ceiling exceptions, Merkle checkpoints, and NIST OSCAL 1.1.2 closure attestations are sealed inside DSSEv1 envelopes signed via non-exportable KMS/HSM EnvelopeSigner, Ed25519, or W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators over RFC 8785 JCS payloads.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.mechanism: internal/adapters/k8s_live.go Streaming WATCH + eBPF/Tetragon In-Pod Drift Quarantine
controls.narrative: Streams event-driven Kubernetes Pod WATCH notifications (?watch=true&allowWatchBookmarks=true&resourceVersion=...) and eBPF/Tetragon container filesystem/process telemetry, automatically re-arming Cilium metadata/egress quarantine bridges, cordoning compromised pods, and recycling clean replicas upon image or in-pod webshell drift even during Emergency Freeze.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.narrative: Grades enterprise services across three graduated autonomy tiers with a mandatory 5th immutable-filesystem gate (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true + noexec /tmp): TIER_1_FULL_AUTONOMOUS (>=80% coverage, OTel probes, CoW/shadow DB, verified rollback, immutable rootfs), TIER_2_GUARDED_CANARY (brownfield SLI-guarded canary with immutable rootfs), and TIER_3_CONTAIN_AND_CAB.

controls.title: Configuration Change Control | Security and Privacy Representatives
controls.narrative: Contains in seconds and verifies rollouts safely across configurable statistical sample/dwell windows using order-insensitive multiset JSON diffing, float epsilon tolerance, eBPF syscall/file/egress guards, and an atomic 3-step Contain-Before-Unban Quarantined Rollback state machine for post-closure latent regressions.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication | Multi-Factor Authentication to Privileged Accounts
controls.mechanism: internal/crypto/webauthn.go Native W3C WebAuthn PIV/FIDO2 Verification
controls.narrative: Authenticates organizational Authorizing Officials and Service Owners via native W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators (RPID SHA-256 binding, User Present & User Verified hardware flags, ECDSA P-256 / Ed25519 verification) and live execution-time revocation checks.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-Organizational Users)
controls.narrative: External scanner, extractor, and rollout workers operate solely as governed delegates under DSSE-signed ephemeral Task Warrants (max TTL 300s) bound to an active human-co-signed Standing Warrant and explicit target asset scope.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.mechanism: policies/verify_closure.rego Differential Twin Positive Control & Dual Assurance Tiers
controls.narrative: Eliminates false-negative closure from broken PoCs by requiring positive-control exploit confirmation against the unpatched digest before accepting EXPLOIT_BLOCKED on the patched digest (ASSURANCE_TIER_2_DIFFERENTIAL_TWIN), while attesting standard Trivy/OSV/KEV advisories without weaponized PoCs under ASSURANCE_TIER_1_PASSIVE_DIGEST_SBOM.

controls.title: Boundary Protection | Deny by Default — Allow by Exception
controls.narrative: Enforces default outbound cloud metadata severance (169.254.169.254/32, 169.254.170.2/32, fd00:ec2::254/128) and external callback blocking (toEntities: world) on every N3 containment bridge, restricting egress strictly to pre-declared internal cluster services while applying L7 Envoy/Cilium filters only when backed by an Ed25519 publisher-signed CWE/CVE rulepack.

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity | Code Authentication
controls.narrative: Verifies publisher Ed25519 provenance on every candidate patch artifact, cryptographically blocks AI diffs mutating CI/CD or coding-agent instructions (.github/, .gitlab-ci, Dockerfile, Makefile, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursor, .gemini/), and sweeps 100% of live pod containerStatuses imageID SHA-256 digests before retiring containment.

controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes
controls.narrative: Maintains a machine-readable CycloneDX 1.5 Software Bill of Materials with 100% SPDX license attribution across all Go, npm, and Python dependencies, enforcing zero GPL/AGPL copyleft contamination and SHA-pinned GitHub Actions.

controls.title: Component Authenticity
controls.narrative: Supports non-exportable external KMS/HSM signing keys for attestation envelopes and enforces permanent Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy + OPA Gatekeeper SHA-256 digest lockouts banning vulnerable container images across the cluster.
